title: The node wrapper orphans the native quest child when the wrapper is killed (DEC-282 (a1) item 7)
description:
CARRIER from ODOC-610 / DEC-282 (a1) ADDED 2026-11-19, opum-doc, after the clock read 02:29:29Z on cont1's follow-up over opum-comm. Read BY REF from opum-doc origin/dev 68734a01 (.quest/planning.json, decision DEC-282, outcome (a1)).

Verbatim from (a1), item 7: "The node wrapper must never orphan the native child. It forwards SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP to the child, and exits with the child's status. On the wrapper's own death the child must not outlive it: run it in its own process group and kill the group, or use an equivalent that leaves no orphan. Proof: a test that kills the wrapper mid-run and finds no surviving quest process. The same rule applies to lore's wrapper if it has one; lore-cli checks."

The live case, also verbatim: "A live case on mbam5 at 02:24Z: the Mac's load was 41, with 4-9 concurrent `quest task list --across-refs --allow-partial --json` processes each running 60-90 s, many orphaned (PPID 1). The caller, a status daemon polling on a 500 ms watch and a 5 s tick with a 60 s timeout, killed only the node wrapper (quest.cjs), so the native quest binary kept running. The repository has 2,313 tasks and 47 worktrees of one clone."

Item 7 is the most urgent of (a1), "because an orphaned native process is a resource leak for any caller with a timeout." It ships with DEC-282 items 1-5 and 8 in the next lore/quest pair release.

Target: bin/quest.cjs (the node wrapper that spawns the native binary) and its tests.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Killing the node wrapper mid-run leaves no surviving quest process: it runs the native child in its own process group and kills the group on its own death, or uses an equivalent that leaves no orphan
The wrapper forwards SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP to the native child and exits with the child's status
A regression test kills the wrapper mid-run and asserts no quest process survives, and that test goes red when the forwarding and group-kill are removed (both directions proven)
bun run check exits 0 with the new test included

implementationNotes: HELD 2026-11-19T03:46:17Z on the leader ruling: bin/quest.cjs is DEC-182 (1) launcher class, the same ruling given for lore bin/lore.cjs, on the rule that when unsure it is sensitive. It is built by a sonnet-or-higher quest-cli session with an opus security review and no DeepSeek at any step; a deepseek-flash session (this one) must not touch bin/quest.cjs. Evidence that it is the launcher in this repository own vocabulary: package.json bin.quest is ./bin/quest.cjs; scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs refuses unless "Root package must be a Node launcher" and pins the packed file set to LICENSE, README.md, bin/quest.cjs, package.json; test/qcli399-launcher-equivalence.test.ts compares "the qualified X-rc.N launcher and the published X launcher" on that same file.
